attacks.name: Bear-Handed Slap
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Bear-Armed Brawler
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Ursine Temper
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less and within |!range| 2, and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Aggressive
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it may Advance |!range_small| Toward the attacker.
